text_block_list.text:
On the way back from training, I stopped 
by the shopping district...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hmm...?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "Huh, a lottery raffle, huh... ...Hm?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I think it was in my pocket... Wait, or 
was it in my bag...?

Tosen Jordan fidgeted around, rummaging 
through her skirt pocket.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah! It's in my phone case! I bought a new 
one for New Year's! I slipped it between 
the case and the phone... Whoa!?
(Slip... clunk!)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Aaaaah!? My phoooone!?
choice_data_list: The screen isn't cracked!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: It's a little cracked...
choice_data_list: My condolences...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa... aaahh...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... Would you like to draw a lottery 
ticket?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Trainerrr...
choice_data_list: I'll do it instead!
I'll do it for you!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah. Is that so! Do your best out 
there!

In place of Tosen Jordan, I 
enthusiastically crank the raffle wheel!
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Awesome! That's amazing! Trainer!! The 
grand prize?!
choice_data_list: It was worth digging those tickets out!

It was worth digging those tickets out, 
wasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"See? See!? That should totally make up 
for the luck I lost when my smartphone 
screen cracked!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: To cover the broken smartphone...
choice_data_list:
It's the grand prize! It's the grand 
prize, so please don't cry!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
A hot spring trip ticket, huh... Hehe, I 
wonder who I should go with~
choice_data_list: You do have plenty of friends, after all.
You have plenty of friends, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Right?! How are you supposed to pick just 
one? Totally impossible, right? I wanna go 
with everyone, but I'm broke!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Maybe we should just sell this ticket and 
all go to karaoke instead~...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list: What's the matter?
What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No, I was just thinking that you were the 
one who won the grand prize.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Looking closely, it hasn't expired yet. 
I'll think a bit more about who to go 
with.
choice_data_list: Have fun while you're there.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...You're a huge idiot too. Show off at a 
time like this, at least.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Like, bragging that you're the one who 
won it, or something.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: !! Whoa, that looks super delicious!
choice_data_list: Do you like Jordan too?
You like Jordan too?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I love it! I love it so much!!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see! Good on ya! Here's your 
prize, missy!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. Yay, it's a carrot hamburg steak!
choice_data_list:
Looks like you're in a better mood now, 
huh.

Looks like you're in a better mood now, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
That look on your face... is so annoying. 
You're treating me like a kid, aren't you? 
Seriously...!

Still, Tosen Jordan's tail was swishing up 
high. It seems she really was happy about 
winning first prize.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~! You did it! Look, Trainer just won 
2nd prize!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ngh, not bad, Trainer!
choice_data_list:
It's a whole cardboard box full of 
carrots!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Seriously!? Isn't that crazy!? You can eat 
so much!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, who should we invite! City, right? 
Palmer and Helios, the usual crew! Oh, and 
let's invite Ticket-san sometimes too~"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Fuha, this is so much fun~.
choice_data_list:
I'm glad to see you've got your energy 
back.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...*Sigh*. I forgot that's just the kind 
of person you are.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Here, hold out your hand.

A single orange carrot was placed onto my 
outstretched palm.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...That's your portion. Make sure you eat 
every last bite.

Since I was given the carrot, I cooked and 
ate it that very day.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Just one carrot...
choice_data_list: I wanted to win a good prize, but...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Forget about it. The way I am right 
now, I might've drawn bad luck anyway. 
This is way better.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Little lady! You forgot your prize, 
little lady!!
choice_data_list: She looks seriously down in the dumps...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's this bag? Inside... carrot 
chips?
choice_data_list:
I tried making this with those carrots 
from the other day.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...You?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Haha, hilarious. Your wood chips are all 
completely different sizes. Cut 'em 
evenly! You're terrible at this~.
choice_data_list: ...Even so, I still gave it my all.
...Even so, I still gave it my all.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Well, I guess I'll take it off your hands.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list: Sorry...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...More importantly. Can you file a claim 
for a phone repair, I wonder...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Is there insurance for that sort of 
thing...?
choice_data_list: ...I'll come with you.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Thaanks...

With her shoulders slumped, Tosen Jordan 
left the shopping district.
